notes.title: MacOS Bugfix
notes.content: Fixed a bug where the game would freeze at startup for some MacOS players.

notes.title: OUT NOW ON MacOS + MORE!
notes.content:
Hi artists,

Here is what we added in the new update:

[b]MAC RELEASE[/b]
Play Drawing from Memory on Apple machines!
 
[b]LANGUAGES[/b]
We added the following interface languages:
- Italian
- Spanish
- French
- German

[b]ACHIEVEMENTS[/b]
Based on feedback and statistics we made some of the harder achievements a bit more achievable.

Please let us know if you encounter any bugs!

notes.title: Impartial Mode update + more...
notes.content:
Hi artists,

Here is what we added in the new update:

[b]- THE IMPARTIAL MODE[/b]
Hide the names of the players before the votes are in.
You can activate this new free mode in the CUSTOM GAME menu.
 
[b]- New prompts added: [/b]
Anime character
Anime Monster
Fantasy Monster
Robot

[b]- Achievement progress.[/b]
You can now follow your progress in the 'Memory of steel' and 'Addicted' achievements.

[b]- Added Fullscreen/ Windowed mode in the option menu.[/b]

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
- Twitch Votes mode input is no longer case sensitive.
- Added a pop up window for cases of severe lag.

Thanks for all the positive feedback since the launch!

notes.title: Bugfix
notes.content: Fixed a bug where the voice over was muted for new players
